results.name: W1 W3C epub-tests: every test opens or errors where required; per-test predicates from dc:description; no script / handler / remote resource survives; CSP in every document
W2 IDPF epub3-samples (45 books): open, every spine document prepared and safe, images / media / styles point to manifest resources, the TOC resolves into the spine
W3 differential vs an independent lxml package reader on every IDPF + W3C book: title, creators, identifier, version, progression, layout, spine, manifest, TOC
C1 an entry compressed with a method other than stored / deflate is an error (W3C ocf-zip-comp), not garbage
C2 a split / spanned archive is refused (W3C ocf-zip-mult)
C3 DRM: a spine document encrypted with any algorithm other than font obfuscation refuses the book with a clear message
C4 IDPF font obfuscation: SHA-1(unique id without XML whitespace) XOR over 1040 bytes round-trips exactly; whitespace in the identifier is ignored
C5 Adobe font obfuscation: the identifier's UUID bytes XOR over 1024 bytes round-trips exactly
C6 the first rootfile of the package media type wins; a non-package rootfile listed first is skipped; path resolution clamps ../ at the root and decodes %20
N1 <script> (XHTML and SVG, any prefix) is removed
N2 event-handler attributes in any case are removed (onload, ONCLICK, svg onbegin)
N3 javascript: links are removed, including entity-encoded and whitespace-split schemes
N4 file: and remote resources are not loaded (img, video poster, audio, source, object)
N5 iframe / frame / embed / applet / base / meta refresh are removed; srcdoc and target attributes go
N6 an <object> that is not an image shows its fallback content instead
N7 CSS: remote @import dropped, remote url() → none, javascript: url() → none, internal @import cycle terminates
N8 DOCTYPE internal-subset entities are never expanded (no billion laughs, no external entity)
N9 path traversal: ../../../../ clamps at the container root and only manifest items load (META-INF files are not reachable)
N10 xml-stylesheet processing instructions and comments are dropped
N11 data: URLs: images stay, data:text/html links and data: scripts do not
N12 SVG <set>/<animate> that retarget href are dropped
N13 malformed XML (unclosed element, a::b names, bad attribute) is an error, never guessed
N14 deep nesting (10 000 levels) fails cleanly instead of overflowing the stack
N15 a zip bomb entry (declared small, inflates huge) is refused
N16 form actions, formaction and ping are removed
N17 external links are kept only as consent-gated data-epub-ext; internal links become data-epub-href (the frame never navigates itself)
N18 hostile package: a manifest item escaping the root, a duplicate id, a missing spine target, an empty spine
N19 not an EPUB / no container / missing package / malformed package → clear errors
N20 -epub- CSS mapping does not touch look-alikes (custom properties, selectors, strings) and maps values
N21 every prepared chapter carries a CSP meta first in <head>: default-src 'none', no script-src, images / media / fonts only from blob: / data:
N22 right-to-left spreads: page-spread-right starts a pair, page-spread-left completes it; left-to-right is the mirror image
